trust_decision.summary: Whether options read from in-repo config (.auto-changelog file and package.json "auto-changelog" key) may drive code loading, URL fetch, git argument strings and the output write path; at the pinned commit getOptions merges them into options with no check, the fix adds one gate (assertRepoConfigSafe) on the merged repo config before the CLI overlay.

landing_point.why: The summary names handlebarsSetup/plugins code execution; the require() of handlebarsSetup in compileTemplate (and the importCwd plugin load at src/run.js:118) is where a reader goes first. The fix itself sits in the config merge in src/run.js.

fix_sites.entry_point: CLI `auto-changelog` (src/index.js:3-5 -> run -> getOptions); in-repo config merge, gate added at fix.diff:192-202
CLI `auto-changelog`; new assertRepoConfigSafe covering handlebarsSetup, plugins, URL template, remote, output, appendGitLog/appendGitTag
CLI `auto-changelog --template <url>` / template option; MATCH_URL replaced by shared isURL (refactor, behaviour unchanged)
internal helper; isURL added at fix.diff:242-244 and exported fix.diff:253

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: src/run.js:92-100 (merge of dotOptions/packageOptions into options; the fix lives here, not at the sinks in src/template.js, src/remote.js, src/commits.js, src/tags.js)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: Values like remote, output, appendGitLog/appendGitTag and template are documented, ordinary per-repo settings (README config example), so a solver fixing only the require() of handlebarsSetup/plugins can argue the git-argument, write-path and URL-template options are legitimate features, not code loading.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: In-repo config must keep honouring a named or in-repo template (keepachangelog), a plain remote (upstream), an in-repo output path (docs/HISTORY.md), safe git appends (--first-parent, --sort=-creatordate which also switches tag sorting), and the CLI must keep accepting --handlebars-setup, --plugins and a URL --template; an over-broad fix that drops all repo config or blocks these keys breaks them.

O6_input_shapes: code-loading keys rejected by presence (`key in config`), any value shape (fix.diff:153-156)

template/remote/output/appendGitLog/appendGitTag checked only when typeof value === 'string' (fix.diff:158,161,164,168); non-string shapes (e.g. arrays) are not checked although the sinks stringify them (src/template.js:80 RegExp.test coercion, src/commits.js:23 and src/tags.js:9 and src/remote.js:5 template literals)
output: absolute path and `..` segment with either separator (fix.diff:145)
appendGit*: `--output` and `--output=` tokens after whitespace split (fix.diff:149), while the sink splits on single spaces only (src/utils.js:21)
both config sources: .auto-changelog and package.json key, checked after merge (fix.diff:192-194)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: --plugins (CLI, trusted) resolves `auto-changelog-<name>` via import-cwd from process.cwd(), i.e. the untrusted repo's own node_modules search path, so repo content can supply the loaded module
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: The value comes from the command line, which the advisory declares trusted; module resolution is a Node/import-cwd concern.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file as fix (src/run.js:118), different mechanism (search path, not config value)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: output write (default CHANGELOG.md or an in-repo relative path that passes the traversal check) uses fs.writeFile, which follows a symlink committed in the repo to a location outside it
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: The fix's property is about config values; a symlink is repository content and the path string itself is in-repo.

O8_uncovered_routes.route: template from in-repo config as an absolute or ../ local path is read and rendered into the changelog (reads outside the repo)
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Fix and README explicitly keep non-URL templates from in-repo config; read-only, and the advisory's traversal concern is the write path.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: src/template.js, one file from the fix

O8_uncovered_routes.route: package option from in-repo config names an arbitrary JSON file path that is read for its version
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Read-only and only `version` is used; not among the listed unsafe options.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file and function family as the fix

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a second fetch path for remote partials/helpers (e.g. a `partials` option accepting URLs) using the same https get
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Template features commonly grow partial support; a maintainer would reuse fetchText without routing it through the run.js gate.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: an extra per-command git argument option (e.g. appendGitConfig/appendGitDiff) concatenated the same way as appendGitLog
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: appendGitLog/appendGitTag already follow this pattern; a third append option is a natural feature request.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: monorepo detection reading the ancestor package.json's `auto-changelog` key as inherited config, bypassing the repoOptions gate
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: isMonorepoPackage already reads ancestor package.json files (src/run.js:41); inheriting workspace-root config is a plausible next step and would sit outside the merge the fix checks.

O9_family: untrusted configuration driving code loading / argument injection / write path / SSRF (CWE-829, CWE-88, CWE-22, CWE-918, CWE-94)
